answer_1.quote: We focus on these three dimensions, as LLMs already excel in other axes like fluency and coherence... This work presents a framework for improving text summarization using LLM-generated feedback.

answer_2.quote: We report the quality of text summary from the three key perspectives... We use ROUGE and BERTScore as conventional metrics... Automated evaluation uses FineSurE percentage scores and Spearman correlation.

answer_3.quote: Feedback is generated through LLM-based summary evaluations using Llama3-70b-instruct... We use FineSurE to acquire high-quality, multi-dimensional, fine-grained feedback at the sentence and key-fact level.

answer_4.quote: We perform a fact verification task for faithfulness and a key-fact alignment task for completeness and conciseness... Three annotators are assigned for each task, recruited through Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators performed fact verification (binary error detection) and key-fact alignment (yes/no per key fact) to assess summary quality.
